newsitem.title: USA: Chicago broadcaster Carol Marin hired by CBS.
newsitem.headline: Chicago broadcaster Carol Marin hired by CBS.

text.p: Carol Marin, who resigned as NBC-TV's Chicago news anchor over the hiring of talk-show host Jerry Springer, signed on with CBS Monday to work on local and network news shows.
Marin, 48, said she was glad to be back as a broadcater in Chicago, "to do the kind of local news I value." She has won several local and national awards for her reporting.

Marin and co-anchor Ron Magers resigned over differences with the managers at WMAQ-TV in Chicago, shortly after talk-show host Jerry Springer was hired to do commentaries. After airing just two editorials, Springer resigned under pressure.
Marin will work with former NBC "Today" show host Bryant Gumbel on his new television newsmagazine for CBS network as well as doing reports for CBS' Chicago television and radio outlets.
